family_comparison.all_parameter_split: E8 unimodular: [[C,U],[U^T,B]] is integrally congruent to C orthogonal (B-U^T C^-1 U).
family_comparison.relative_fixed_source_normal_forms: E8 orthogonal [[-2phi,0],[0,2d]] or [[-2phi,-1],[-1,2d]], d in O; three tested integer d values do not exhaust this family.

local_obstruction.anisotropic_quaternary: I2 orthogonal beta I2; mod-beta descent forces every coordinate divisible beta.
local_obstruction.maximal_integral: Only beta can divide a proper overlattice index. On beta^-1 I2, integrality requires a²+b²=0 mod beta, hence the vector was already integral.

norm_and_zero.complete_norm_argument: beta*G^-1 is integral; reflection integrality gives2beta*r/q integral. Primitive-coordinate Bezout therefore gives q|2beta. Positive units are squares, leaving1,2,beta,2beta.
norm_and_zero.zero_mixing_bound: Norm(nonzero coordinate)^2<=4/11<1 after the beta residue condition, impossible.
norm_and_zero.root_count_convention: Unit-normalized to norms1,2,beta,2beta; opposite directions counted separately.

scope: New exact admissible maximal-integral H9 lattice, not similar to ANY E8-plus-binary form over Qsqrt5. Complete primitive norm alphabet and zero sector. No positive-height search, finite-volume example, or universal nonreflectivity claim for the earlier one-parameter family.
